description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Notice under Universities Act, that the conditions when admitting students for the degree programmes to National School of Business Management Limited
reasoning: This gazette content is an Order made under Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, which amends the schedule of a previous Order. It establishes regulatory conditions for degree programs and their entry qualifications at a specific institution. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation under existing acts, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes). While a minister is named, this is incidental to the primary purpose of publishing regulatory amendments, not the main focus of the gazette notice.
